questions.hindiQuestion: लाइन ग्राफ के अनुसार, 2003 के दौरान कंपनी में कितने कर्मचारी कार्यरत थे?

questions.question: For which year was the percentage rise or fall in the number of employees who left the company, compared with the previous year, maximum?
questions.hindiQuestion: पिछले वर्ष की तुलना में कंपनी छोड़ने वाले कर्मचारियों की संख्या में प्रतिशत वृद्धि या कमी किस वर्ष अधिकतम थी?
questions.explanation: In 2002, employees leaving rose from 400 to 600, a rise of (200/400) × 100 = 50%. In other years: 2003 was −8.3%, 2004 was −9.1%, 2005 was +20%, 2006 was +8.3%. Maximum change was 50% in 2002.

questions.question: From 2002 to 2003, by approximately what percent did the employee strength increase or decrease?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2002 से 2003 तक, कर्मचारियों की संख्या में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि या कमी हुई?
questions.explanation: Strength in 2002 = 4950. Strength in 2003 = 5000. Increase = 50. % increase = (50 / 4950) × 100 ≈ 1.01% ≈ 1%.

questions.explanation: If 52° corresponds to ₹26 lakh (i.e. ₹0.5 lakh per degree), then 145° corresponds to 145 × 0.5 = ₹72.5 lakh = ₹72,50,000.

questions.question: If Company B's expenditure in 2002 was ₹200 crore, what was its income in 2002?

questions.explanation: Income = Expenditure × (1 + Profit/100) = 200 × (1 + 30/100) = 200 × 1.30 = ₹260 crore.

questions.question: If A and B had equal expenditures in 2001 and their total income was ₹342 crore, what was their combined profit?
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि 2001 में A और B का व्यय समान था और उनकी कुल आय ₹342 करोड़ थी, तो उनका संयुक्त लाभ क्या था?
questions.explanation: Total Income = 1.45 E + 1.40 E = 2.85 E = 342 => E = 342 / 2.85 = 120 crore. Total Expenditure = 2 × 120 = 240 crore. Combined Profit = Total Income − Total Expenditure = 342 − 240 = ₹102 crore.
questions.graphDescription: Profit % line graph: 2005: Company A profit = 70%, Company B profit = 50%. Income = Expenditure × (1 + P/100).

questions.question: Company A's expenditure in 2003 was ₹200 crore, and its income in 2003 equalled its expenditure in 2006. What was its income in 2006?
questions.hindiQuestion: 2003 में कंपनी A का व्यय ₹200 करोड़ था, और 2003 में इसकी आय 2006 में इसके व्यय के बराबर थी। 2006 में इसकी आय क्या थी?
questions.explanation: Income in 2003 = 200 × 1.60 = ₹320 crore = Expenditure in 2006. In 2006, Profit % = 45%. Income in 2006 = 320 × 1.45 = ₹464 crore.

questions.question: Find the time taken by train A to pass train C if they are travelling in the same direction.
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि ट्रेन A और ट्रेन C एक ही दिशा में यात्रा कर रही हैं, तो ट्रेन A द्वारा ट्रेन C को पार करने में लिया गया समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Solving individual lengths and speeds from system of equations: Length(A) = 330 m, Length(C) = 530 m. Relative speed in same direction = |sA − sC| = 10 m/s. Crossing time = (330 + 530) / 10 = 860 / 10 = 86 seconds.
questions.verificationNote: Reading the upper curve as train lengths (in decametres) and lower curve as crossing times (in seconds) is the verified interpretation reconciling all questions Q463–Q467.

Lower line = Crossing time in opposite directions: A+B: 12 s, B+C: 20 s, C+D: 25 s, D+E: 10 s, E+A: 12 s.

questions.question: Find the approximate time taken by train B and train D to cross each other if both are travelling in opposite directions.
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि ट्रेन B और ट्रेन D दोनों विपरीत दिशाओं में यात्रा कर रही हैं, तो एक-दूसरे को पार करने में उनके द्वारा लिया गया अनुमानित समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Sum of lengths B + D = 270 + 170 = 440 m. Relative speed in opposite direction = sB + sD = 22 + 23 = 45 m/s. Time = 440 / 45 ≈ 9.777 s ≈ 9.78 seconds.
questions.graphDescription: Line graph for pairs of trains: Upper line = Sum of lengths in decametres (1 dm = 10 m): A+B = 60 dm (600 m), B+C = 80 dm (800 m), C+D = 70 dm (700 m), D+E = 50 dm (500 m), E+A = 66 dm (660 m). questions.question: If train E crosses a platform of a certain length in 50 seconds, find the approximate time taken by train D to cross the same platform.

questions.explanation: Platform length: Distance = (Length E + L_plat) = 28 × 50 = 1400 m => L_plat = 1400 − 330 = 1070 m. For train D: Length D = 170 m, Speed D = 13.5 m/s. Total distance = 1070 + 170 = 1240 m. Time = 1240 / 13.5 ≈ 91.82 seconds.

questions.question: Train A was travelling from Patna to Delhi while train D was travelling from Delhi to Patna. Train A started 2 hours after train D. If both trains meet at a distance of 297 km from Delhi, find the approximate distance between Patna and Delhi.
questions.hindiQuestion: ट्रेन A पटना से दिल्ली जा रही थी जबकि ट्रेन D दिल्ली से पटना जा रही थी। ट्रेन A, ट्रेन D के 2 घंटे बाद चली। यदि दोनों ट्रेनें दिल्ली से 297 किमी की दूरी पर मिलती हैं, तो पटना और दिल्ली के बीच की अनुमानित दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Speed of Train D in km/h: Train D travels 297 km. Time taken by D = t. Train A travels for (t − 2) hours. Using the derived speed ratio and speeds, distance covered by Train A is ≈ 232.2 km. Total distance between Patna and Delhi = 297 + 232.2 = 529.2 km.

questions.explanation: Difference in travel times: Time for C = 414 / vC, Time for B = 414 / vB. Difference = 414/vC − 414/vB ≈ 5.96 hours.

questions.explanation: South zone = 23%, West zone = 16%. Combined % = 23% + 16% = 39%. Sum = 39% of 125 crores = 0.39 × 125 = 48.75 crores.

questions.question: In India, the ratio of males to females is 13 : 12 and in the central zone the ratio of males to females is 9 : 7. The number of females in the central zone is what percentage of the total number of females of India?
questions.hindiQuestion: भारत में पुरुषों और महिलाओं का अनुपात 13 : 12 है और मध्य क्षेत्र में पुरुषों और महिलाओं का अनुपात 9 : 7 है। मध्य क्षेत्र में महिलाओं की संख्या, भारत की कुल महिलाओं की संख्या का कितना प्रतिशत है?
questions.explanation: Let India population = 100. Total females in India = (12/25) × 100 = 48. Central zone population = 20. Females in central zone = (7/16) × 20 = 140 / 16 = 35 / 4 = 8.75. Percentage = (8.75 / 48) × 100 = 875 / 48 % = 18 11/48 %.

questions.question: 50% of the total population of the west zone are males, which is equal to 10% of the total population of males in India. If the total population of females in the west zone is 50 million, what is the total population of males in India?

questions.explanation: If 50% are males, the remaining 50% are females = 50 million. Hence west zone males = 50 million. If 10% of total males in India = 50 million, total males in India = 50 / 0.10 = 500 million.

questions.question: Find the approximate time taken to fill the tank if pipes A, B, D, R and S are opened together.
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि पाइप A, B, D, R और S को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो टंकी को भरने में लगने वाला अनुमानित समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Inlet flow rate A+B+D = (20% + 15% + 10%) of 500 = 45% of 500 = 225 L/min. Outlet flow rate R+S = (8% + 4%) of 625 = 12% of 625 = 75 L/min. Net fill rate = 225 − 75 = 150 L/min. Time to fill 1000 L = 1000 / 150 = 6.67 minutes.
questions.graphDescription: Inlet pipes (A: 20%, B: 15%, C: 25%, D: 10%, E: 30%). Time all inlets open = 2 mins => Flow rate = 1000/2 = 500 L/min. Outlet pipes (P: 48%, Q: 30%, R: 8%, S: 4%, T: 10%). Time all outlets open = 1.6 mins => Flow rate = 1000/1.6 = 625 L/min.
questions.graphSvg: Graph Set 12: Tank Flow Distribution (Inlet Pipes vs. Outlet Pipes)

questions.question: If all the inlet pipes and the outlet pipes are opened together, find the time taken to empty the full tank.
questions.hindiQuestion: यदि सभी इनलेट और आउटलेट पाइपों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो भरी हुई टंकी को खाली करने में कितना समय लगेगा?
questions.explanation: Net emptying rate = 625 − 500 = 125 L/min. Time to empty full 1000 L tank = 1000 / 125 = 8 minutes.
questions.graphDescription: Inlet pipes (A: 20%, B: 15%, C: 25%, D: 10%, E: 30%). Time all inlets open = 2 mins => Flow rate = 1000/2 = 500 L/min. Outlet pipes (P: 48%, Q: 30%, R: 8%, S: 4%, T: 10%). Time all outlets open = 1.6 mins => Flow rate = 1000/1.6 = 625 L/min.
questions.graphSvg: Graph Set 12: Tank Flow Distribution (Inlet Pipes vs. Outlet Pipes)

questions.question: Find the ratio of the sum of the time taken by pipe C alone and pipe D alone to fill the tank to the sum of the time taken by pipe R alone and pipe T alone to empty the tank.
questions.hindiQuestion: पाइप C अकेले और पाइप D अकेले द्वारा टंकी भरने में लिए गए समय के योग का पाइप R अकेले और पाइप T अकेले द्वारा टंकी खाली करने में लिए गए समय के योग से अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Time C to fill = 1000 / 125 = 8 min. Time D to fill = 1000 / 50 = 20 min. Sum of fill times = 8 + 20 = 28 min. Time R to empty = 1000 / 50 = 20 min. Time T to empty = 1000 / 62.5 = 16 min. Sum of empty times = 20 + 16 = 36 min. Ratio = 28 : 36 = 7 : 9.
questions.graphDescription: Inlet pipes (A: 20%, B: 15%, C: 25%, D: 10%, E: 30%). Time all inlets open = 2 mins => Flow rate = 1000/2 = 500 L/min. Outlet pipes (P: 48%, Q: 30%, R: 8%, S: 4%, T: 10%). Time all outlets open = 1.6 mins => Flow rate = 1000/1.6 = 625 L/min.

questions.question: What will be the ratio of the time taken by pipes P and R together to empty the tank to the time taken by pipes Q, S and T together to empty the tank?
questions.hindiQuestion: पाइप P और R द्वारा एक साथ टंकी खाली करने में लिए गए समय का पाइप Q, S और T द्वारा एक साथ टंकी खाली करने में लिए गए समय से अनुपात क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Emptying rate of P + R = (48% + 8%) of 625 = 56% of 625. Rate of Q + S + T = (30% + 4% + 10%) of 625 = 44% of 625. Time is inversely proportional to rate, so Time(P+R) / Time(Q+S+T) = Rate(Q+S+T) / Rate(P+R) = 44% / 56% = 11 / 14.
questions.graphDescription: Inlet pipes (A: 20%, B: 15%, C: 25%, D: 10%, E: 30%). Time all inlets open = 2 mins => Flow rate = 1000/2 = 500 L/min. Outlet pipes (P: 48%, Q: 30%, R: 8%, S: 4%, T: 10%). Time all outlets open = 1.6 mins => Flow rate = 1000/1.6 = 625 L/min.

question.en: What is the respective ratio of total number of shirts sold from shop A in 2024 to the total number of shirts sold from shop C in 2022?
question.hi: 2024 में दुकान A से बेची गई शर्टों की कुल संख्या का 2022 में दुकान C से बेची गई शर्टों की कुल संख्या से क्रमशः अनुपात क्या है?

explanation.en: Shirts sold from Shop A in 2024 = 3200. Shirts sold from Shop C in 2022 = 4000. Ratio = 3200 : 4000 = 4 : 5.

questions.graphDescription: Pie chart showing percentage distribution of 12,000 satellites launched by five countries: Norway (30%), Belgium (25%), Ireland (20%), Canada (15%), Romania (10%).

question.en: Find the average number of satellites launched by Ireland, Belgium and Norway.
question.hi: आयरलैंड, बेल्जियम और नॉर्वे द्वारा प्रक्षेपित उपग्रहों की औसत संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

explanation.en: Total satellites = 12000. Ireland (20%) = 2400; Belgium (25%) = 3000; Norway (30%) = 3600. Sum = 9000. Average = 9000 / 3 = 3000.

question.en: The ratio of the number of remote and communication satellites launched by Canada is 3 : 2. Find the number of communication satellites launched by Canada. (Consider only remote and communication satellites launched by Canada)
question.hi: कनाडा द्वारा प्रक्षेपित दूरस्थ और संचार उपग्रहों की संख्या का अनुपात 3 : 2 है। कनाडा द्वारा प्रक्षेपित संचार उपग्रहों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए। (केवल कनाडा द्वारा प्रक्षेपित दूरस्थ और संचार उपग्रहों पर विचार करें)

explanation.en: Total satellites for Canada = 15% of 12000 = 1800. Ratio = 3 : 2 (total 5 parts). Communication satellites = (2 / 5) × 1800 = 720.

question.en: Ratio of the number of network and agriculture related satellites launched by Romania is 7 : 8. Find the number of agriculture related satellites launched by Romania. (Consider only the network and agriculture related satellites launched by Romania)
question.hi: रोमानिया द्वारा प्रक्षेपित नेटवर्क और कृषि संबंधी उपग्रहों की संख्या का अनुपात 7 : 8 है। रोमानिया द्वारा प्रक्षेपित कृषि संबंधी उपग्रहों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए। (केवल रोमानिया द्वारा प्रक्षेपित नेटवर्क और कृषि संबंधी उपग्रहों पर विचार करें)

explanation.en: Romania total = 10% of 12000 = 1200. Ratio = 7 : 8 (15 parts). Agriculture satellites = (8 / 15) × 1200 = 8 × 80 = 640.
